ticket.title: Add CONTRACTS.md and a wire-contract gate for the four egress surfaces
ticket.description: Aerofoil serialises one aircraft record to four surfaces: JSON-lines, gRPC/protobuf, MCP tool schemas, and (later) a TypeScript web client. SPEC 5 fixes the semantics and the framing rules but not the fields, so drift between a Rust struct and its TypeScript or protobuf counterpart would be caught by nothing until a consumer breaks. The gaugeblock suite solves this with a CONTRACTS.md plus miter contracts --check; aerofoil needs the document and the gate, but only once a second representation exists, because a gate with nothing to compare is a gate that passes for the wrong reason.
acceptance_criteria: docs/CONTRACTS.md exists with one section per surface, each field carrying name, type, optionality, units and schema version; wire types state their derives and any deliberate exception; SPEC 5 links to CONTRACTS.md rather than restating fields, so there is exactly one field-level source of truth; miter contracts --check joins Tier 3 only once the TypeScript client types exist, and the entry is added in the same commit as that client; protobuf compatibility is covered by a prost round-trip test or buf breaking check because miter contracts does not read .proto files; a breaking field change is a BREAKING CHANGE commit with a lockstep bump

verification_receipt.summary: [window: no base commit could be named, so this receipt covers HEAD only]
